parts.name: Fundus of the uterus
parts.description: HRA node `VH_F_fundus_of_uterus` (FMA:17561, 'Fundus of uterus'): a named sub-part of the uterus in the HRA 3D Reference Object Library (united-female v1.10); open surface of 3062 triangles, spans about 41 x 21 x 22 mm in the HRA frame.
